in_marathi.name: Pasu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pasu', meaning 'Animal'. This name is often used in Hindu mythology and literature for various deities and creatures associated with the animal kingdom.
